1//! The `hmtx` table contains the horizontal metrics for each glyph.
2//! All we need to do is to rewrite the table so that it matches the
3//! sequence of the new glyphs. A minor pain point is that the table
4//! allows omitting the advance width for the last few glyphs if it is
5//! the same. In order to keep the code simple, we do not keep this optimization
6//! when rewriting the table.
7//! While doing so, we also rewrite the `hhea` table, which contains
8//! the number of glyphs that contain both, advance width and
9//! left side bearing metrics.
10
11// The parsing logic was taken from ttf-parser.
12
13use super::*;
14use crate::Error::OverflowError;
15
16pub fn subset(ctx: &mut Context) -> Result<()> {
17    let hmtx = ctx.expect_table(Tag::HMTX).ok_or(MalformedFont)?;
18
19    let new_metrics = {
20        let mut new_metrics = vec![];
21
22        match &ctx.interjector {
23            Interjector::Dummy(_) => extract_metrics(hmtx, &mut new_metrics, ctx)?,
24            #[cfg(feature = "variable-fonts")]
25            Interjector::Skrifa(s) => {
26                for old_gid in ctx.mapper.remapped_gids() {
27                    new_metrics.push(s.horizontal_metrics(old_gid).ok_or(MalformedFont)?);
28                }
29            }
30        }
31
32        new_metrics
33    };
34
35    // Find out the last index we need to include the advance width for.
36    let mut last_advance_width_index =
37        u16::try_from(new_metrics.len()).map_err(|_| OverflowError)? - 1;
38    let last_advance_width = new_metrics[last_advance_width_index as usize].0;
39
40    for gid in new_metrics.iter().rev().skip(1) {
41        if gid.0 == last_advance_width {
42            last_advance_width_index -= 1;
43        } else {
44            break;
45        }
46    }
47
48    let mut sub_hmtx = Writer::new();
49
50    for (index, metric) in new_metrics.iter().enumerate() {
51        let index = u16::try_from(index).map_err(|_| OverflowError)?;
52        if index <= last_advance_width_index {
53            sub_hmtx.write::<u16>(metric.0);
54        }
55
56        sub_hmtx.write::<i16>(metric.1);
57    }
58
59    ctx.push(Tag::HMTX, sub_hmtx.finish());
60
61    let hhea = ctx.expect_table(Tag::HHEA).ok_or(MalformedFont)?;
62    let mut sub_hhea = Writer::new();
63    sub_hhea.extend(&hhea[0..hhea.len() - 2]);
64    sub_hhea.write::<u16>(last_advance_width_index + 1);
65
66    ctx.push(Tag::HHEA, sub_hhea.finish());
67
68    Ok(())
69}
70
71fn extract_metrics(
72    hmtx: &[u8],
73    new_metrics: &mut Vec<(u16, i16)>,
74    ctx: &mut Context,
75) -> Result<()> {
76    // Extract the number of horizontal metrics from the `hhea` table.
77    let num_h_metrics = {
78        let hhea = ctx.expect_table(Tag::HHEA).ok_or(MalformedFont)?;
79        let mut r = Reader::new(hhea);
80        r.skip_bytes(34);
81        r.read::<u16>().ok_or(MalformedFont)?
82    };
83
84    let last_advance_width = {
85        let index = 4 * num_h_metrics.checked_sub(1).ok_or(OverflowError)? as usize;
86        let mut r = Reader::new(hmtx.get(index..).ok_or(MalformedFont)?);
87        r.read::<u16>().ok_or(MalformedFont)?
88    };
89
90    for old_gid in ctx.mapper.remapped_gids() {
91        let has_advance_width = old_gid < num_h_metrics;
92
93        let offset = if has_advance_width {
94            old_gid as usize * 4
95        } else {
96            let num_h_metrics = num_h_metrics as usize;
97            num_h_metrics * 4 + (old_gid as usize - num_h_metrics) * 2
98        };
99
100        let mut r = Reader::new(hmtx.get(offset..).ok_or(MalformedFont)?);
101
102        if has_advance_width {
103            let adv = r.read::<u16>().ok_or(MalformedFont)?;
104            let lsb = r.read::<i16>().ok_or(MalformedFont)?;
105            new_metrics.push((adv, lsb));
106        } else {
107            new_metrics.push((last_advance_width, r.read::<i16>().ok_or(MalformedFont)?));
108        }
109    }
110
111    Ok(())
112}
